name: tiny-go-mcp
title: Tiny Go MCP Server
description: Reference stdio MCP server (add, subtract, greet) for testing MCP clients and evaluating tinymcp—not for production workloads. Use when you need a minimal official go-sdk server with demo tools or a ~5MB Docker image. Do not use when you need HTTP/SSE, resources/prompts, or real domain tools (use domain MCP servers instead). For building servers: prefer tinymcp for thin stdio wrappers; use mcp-go for richer helpers/transports; use go-sdk alone for full control.

tiny-go-mcp.name: tiny-go-mcp
tiny-go-mcp.description: Reference tinymcp server (demo tools only). Use to verify stdio MCP wiring in Cursor/Claude/Glama; do not use as a calculator or greeting backend—compute or reply in the agent instead. Tools: use add for addition tests, subtract for subtraction tests, greet for text-tool tests; use go-sdk/mcp-go or a domain server when you need production features.
